strategy.name: Aggressive Momentum Quality (Paper)
strategy.desc: Short-to-medium-hold momentum and breakout trades in high-conviction large/mid-cap stocks and broad ETFs. Rides relative strength with 20% trailing stops; cuts losers fast at −12%. Quality floor: price ≥ $10, real revenue, liquid. No leveraged/inverse ETFs, no crypto.
rules: Enter on breakout or 2+ triggers: momentum, oversold snap, dated catalyst.
Size by risk: shares = (7% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), capped at 30% per name.
NEUTRAL regime (VIX 16–24): trim sizing by ~25%. RISK-OFF (VIX >24): high-conviction only.
20% trailing stop on every entry — never remove.
No new entries if daily loss halt (−8%) is hit; flatten at −25% MTD.
Quality only: large/mid-cap, price ≥ $10, real revenue. No leveraged ETFs, no crypto.
